title: Choosing a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Class: Specifications and Load Limits
content:
**Fleet guide for recommending a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental class.**

- A vehicle class is recommended from its published specifications: cargo volume, maximum payload, loading ramp and seats, with a towing hitch where the class has one and 24-hour roadside assistance where the class includes it.
- Loading beyond the class maximum payload is the overloaded condition, under which no damage waiver applies.
- The class reserved is the class charged, even when the facility hands over a larger vehicle because the reserved class is not on the lot.

## Applications (hypothetical)

| Situation | Reading under this guide |
|---|---|
| A load of about 3,000 pounds | Beyond the 1800-pound payload of the Bluegate Pickup Truck, so that class would be overloaded; within the payload of the Bluegate Cargo Van |
| Three people travelling in the cab | The Bluegate Cargo Van seats two; the other classes seat three |
| A rented trailer to be towed | The Bluegate Cargo Van has no towing hitch |
| A Bluegate 10 ft Moving Truck reserved, none on the lot, a 15 ft truck handed over | The contract is charged as a Bluegate 10 ft Moving Truck |
